fields.summary: Versioning the root node causes exception

comments.body:
I would suggest we disallow root versioning, both in:

  • HTML UI, and
  • VersionServiceImpl.java

No one  has yet noticed this bug which has been around for at least a year.  It should also be noted that whole repositories can be effectively versioned with the import/export utility.   Therefore it is probably best to return a 405 (Method Not Allowed) in response.
I'm closing this issue as part of a jira repository scrubbing. It appears to be out of date, no longer applicable, or addressed by future versions of Fedora.
